messages.author: e83d54ec65b5b8e6
messages.subject: shiny server on OSX
parts:
I am following the instructions for installing a shiny server on my Mac. The one thing I am missing is the OSX equivalent of

# Create a system account to run Shiny apps
useradd -r shiny
# Create a root directory for your website
mkdir -p /var/shiny-server/www
# Create a directory for application logs
mkdir -p /var/shiny-server/log

The mkdir stuff should work, but how do I create the shiny user with the correct permissions and groups.
OSX does not have useradd.
Can anybody tell me the correct command?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: shiny server on OSX
parts:
See the answers and comments here:
http://serverfault.com/questions/182347/add-daemon-account-on-os-x

However, Shiny Server won't work perfectly on the Mac--R processes are successfully launched, but they will not be successfully killed when they are no longer needed.

messages.author: bbc57ffa8a14ad13
messages.subject: Re: shiny server on OSX
parts:
We've patched the development version, so the current code on GitHub (which is NOT guaranteed to be stable and certainly isn't recommended for production use) should actually work just fine on OSX.

The version on npm, however, likely will not kill the R processes reliably.

-Aaron

messages.author: 59a50764ec95c799
messages.subject: Re: shiny server on OSX
parts:
The launcher.cc file needs to be edited to use the proc_pidpath() function on OSX instead of Linux proc. If you apply the changes outlined in Nathan Weeks' commit here and then recompile (run through the cmake part of the install) then it will work fine one Macintosh OSX.

-Mark
